title: Who actually carries the incident journey
subtitle: The 184 items on the service blueprint, counted by the role that performs them. The manager carries more of this service than anyone else, which is why the recommendations went to the manager's routine rather than to the software.
note: The business assumed location explained why reporting varied. The blueprint says the manager touches almost half of the service, and the research found the same thing in the field.
source: Counted from the 184 blueprint items held in the research tool's database.
